card.name: Resuscitation wording after cardiac arrest
card.fires_on: The word right before resuscitation terms, such as prolonged or standard, in sentences that begin 'If cardiac arrest should occur'. Also fires partway through cardiopulmonary.

modes.label: Adjective before resuscitation
modes.description: Words like prolonged or standard that come right after 'If cardiac arrest should occur' and lead into resuscitative efforts or measures.
modes.example: If cardiac arrest should occur, successful outcome may require<< prolonged>> resuscitative efforts.

modes.label: Inside cardiopulmonary
modes.description: Partway through the word cardiopulmonary just before resuscitation.
modes.example: Asystole should be handled by the usual measures including cardiopul<<monary>> resuscitation.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward resuscitation and chest compression words such as compress, cardi and chest.
card.plain: It lights up in overdose text when cardiac arrest is mentioned and the next words will describe resuscitation.
